headline: Markets closed for weekend; focus shifts to FPI outflows, crude oil prices, and upcoming Monday triggers.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 21 September.

why: FPI outflows from Indian equities reached ₹20,974 crore in September amidst ongoing selloffs.
Movement in crude oil prices and the West Asia situation are expected to drive stock market trends.
India's exports to core BRICS markets surged 34% to $19.9 billion during April-August.
State Bank of India issued an advisory warning of potential disruptions due to a nationwide three-day bank strike.
whatHappening: Titan announced plans to consider acquiring smaller brands to capture growth in the premium segment.
A-One Steels India announced an upcoming IPO to raise ₹405 crore.
Oriental Insurance plans an investment of ₹500 crore to strengthen digital capabilities.
Key stocks including Mazagon Dock, RVNL, and Nestle India are set to be in focus ahead of the trading week.
summary:
Indian stock markets are closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, September 21.
Investors are watching global cues, crude oil movements, and heavy FPI selloffs as key drivers for the week.
Specific stocks such as Titan, SBI, Mazagon Dock, and RVNL remain in focus for upcoming trading sessions.
